title: Offscreen targets, feedback and persistence
summary: Render into textures, reuse previous frames and manage persistent resources across graph rebuilds.

blocks.text: RenderTarget takes a Scene and options or a name/options overload. It allocates a layer for isolation, maintains scene update participation, creates an appropriate view/camera and can expose a Sprite of the result. add/capture attach entities to the target’s layer without making them disappear from the scene’s update system.

cells: Render selected entities to a texture
Swap after producer work is complete
Attachments and formats must match consumer shaders

blocks.text: RenderTarget.blur and blurIterations control target blur passes. FeedbackPass keeps a reusable image of the previous frame for trails or recursive sampling. Persistent region drawing avoids clearing selected output but changes the meaning of “redraw”; clear old pixels explicitly when an object moves and should not leave a trace.

Do not sample a texture while writing the same subresource in an incompatible pass. Use ping-pong textures and explicit graph edges. Keep resolution and format consistent with the shaders sampling the target. Texture getters can be null before the GPU resource has been materialized.
One captured circle appears only through one offscreen texture.
